title: Instructing the Machine: First Python Program
description:
Computers do not guess what you want—they execute your exact instructions. Write a Python script to display the machine status and compute a quick calculation.

Task Requirements:
1. Print "System Online" on the first line.
2. Calculate and print 5 * 10 (outputs 50) on the second line.
starter_code:
# The computer follows your exact instructions!
# Complete the code below to match the target output:

print("System Online")
print(5 * 10)
